excerpt.zh: 监护者协议955-1失败。[Root.GetName]已证明自己无法克制攻击行为。解除思潮限制。启动惩罚协议。准备部署战争资产……
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail aggressive acts. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...
